Marissa / Lukas - quick summary from infra/devops:

EU region availability:
- Hosted API (production-grade): available in eu-west-1 (Ireland) and eu-central-1 (Frankfurt). Both are configured to keep persisted customer data in-region when accounts are provisioned in an EU region.
- Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity): we can provision dedicated pools in eu-central-1 and eu-west-1; lead time ~2-4 weeks depending on capacity and instance mix.
- Private VPC (customer VPC + control plane model): Supported in eu-central-1 today; we can do customer-managed VPC peering or AWS PrivateLink. Onboarding lead time for Private VPC is typically 6-10 weeks (security review, network setup, customer infra work).

APAC access considerations:
- APAC hosted endpoints exist in ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) for customers who opt to provision there. However, for NordBank's constraint (production data must remain in EU), we cannot persist production tokens or logs in APAC.
- Options to support low-latency APAC users while keeping primary data in EU:
  * Edge inference w/ proxy routing: route requests through a Singapore edge that forwards inference requests to EU-hosted inference, with no persistent storage in APAC. This reduces latency for round-trip but still incurs EU-hosted compute and cross-region network egress.
  * Read-only replica pattern: not recommended for PII/regulated datasets because replication implies data residency outside the EU.
  * Client-side caching / SDK optimization: cache non-sensitive prefix/context locally in APAC clients and route generation calls to EU.

Compliance & procurement artifacts:
- We can provide SOC2 Type II, SIG-Lite, and our network architecture diagram. I'll attach the region availability grid.

Cost / MAP guidance (high level):
- Private VPC: higher initial setup (one-time engineering & network integration) and a platform license; lower long-term per-token cost for heavy sustained usage. Onboarding: 6-10 weeks.
- Dedicated: mid-level setup time (2-4 weeks), predictable monthly commit, less integration effort vs Private.
- Hosted API (EU): fastest time-to-value, minimal setup, but does not meet production EU-only residency requirement for NordBank.

Action items:
- Marissa: I'll upload the region grid and a short TCO delta for Private vs Dedicated to the MAP doc by EOD today.
- Lukas: if Procurement can share SIG-Lite template, we'll complete it and return within 3 business days.
